arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Edwin Kneedler argued the law exempts interpretive rule changes from public comment.
Ms. Ho argued the agency must follow public comment rules when changing its interpretation.
Justice Scalia suggested the Court should not defer to agency interpretations of its own rules.
Justice Kennedy asked if a background principle favors interpretive rules over regulations.

paragraphs: This case determines if agencies can change their views on worker pay without public input. It affects how many workers receive overtime pay. It shapes the balance between agency flexibility and public participation.
